title: Student Technology Device Program Business Office Guidance on Payments and Credit Refunds
content:
**Rule.** Charges on a Student Technology Device Program loan are paid by the accepted payment methods and are applied to the loan's oldest open charge first. Charges on a loan totalling at least the payment plan threshold may be paid in 3 equal monthly payments, the last carrying any remaining cents. A credit balance is refunded by district check within 30 calendar days, and a refund is issued only on a loan in status returned or charged off.

## Questions answered from the rule

**Which charge does a payment go to?** The oldest open charge on the loan first. With hypothetical open charges on one loan of 20.00 posted first and 50.00 posted later, a payment of 30.00 clears the 20.00 and leaves 40.00 open on the later charge.

**How are monthly payments figured?** The charges on the loan are divided into 3 equal monthly payments and the last carries any remaining cents. A hypothetical charge total of 145.00 is paid as 48.33, 48.33 and 48.34.

**Are monthly payments available on any balance?** They are available when the charges on the loan total at least the payment plan threshold; the charges may then be paid that way.

**How is a credit balance refunded?** By district check, within 30 calendar days.

**On which loans is a refund issued?** Only on a loan whose status in the program's records is returned or charged off.

| Hypothetical loan status | Refund of a credit balance issued |
|---|---|
| Returned | Permitted |
| Charged off | Permitted |
| Checked out | Not issued |
| In repair | Not issued |
| Reported lost | Not issued |

The status is read from the program's loan record for that same loan, before the refund.
